content.title: Longest Palindromic Substring
content.description: Given a string s, return the longest palindromic substring in s.
constraints: s consist of only digits and English letters
hints: I will expand around each character as the center
Nice approach! Expanding around centers works in O(n^2). Do you know a more optimized algorithm like Manacher's?
Remember to handle both odd and even length palindromes
For each center, expand outward while characters match
edge_cases: String with no palindrome longer than 1
follow_up_questions: Can you implement Manacher's algorithm for O(n) time complexity?
How would you count all palindromic substrings instead of finding the longest?
What if you needed to find the longest palindromic subsequence instead?
